job.title: Senior IT Consultant eCommerce - AI solutions (Fashion)

tailoring.headline: Senior IT Consultant eCommerce | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & AI-Assisted Delivery
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Senior IT Consultant and SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience building scalable platforms, OCC REST APIs, and data integrations for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise bridging business requirements and technical execution, translating complex functional needs into robust architecture, and leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, development, and delivery. SAP Certified.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior IT Consultant eCommerce - AI solutions (Fashion)
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the Senior IT Consultant eCommerce role at Metyis, supporting the high-impact digital growth and technology capabilities of HUGO BOSS at the Digital Campus. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise bridging business requirements and technical execution.

bullets.label: Bridging Business & Tech
bullets.text: Extensive experience translating business requirements into technical concepts, writing user stories, and guiding implementation across international development teams.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Delivery
bullets.text: Extensive use of generative AI tools and LLMs to accelerate analysis, development, testing, and technical documentation within agile delivery cycles.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Proven track record designing customer-facing backend and frontend capabilities, OCC REST APIs, and seamless integrations on SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Platform Scalability
bullets.text: Hands-on expertise optimizing database queries, managing PIM/ERP integrations, and supporting high-performance enterprise digital platforms in production.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support your goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to join Metyis and the HUGO BOSS Digital Campus to contribute to a state-of-the-art tech ecosystem in the fashion industry. My background in enterprise e-commerce, techno-functional analysis, and AI-assisted delivery aligns perfectly with your mission to drive high-impact digital experiences and advanced technological growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving enterprise e-commerce solutions, bridging business needs with technical execution, and leveraging AI-assisted delivery for premium digital platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw the Senior IT Consultant eCommerce role at Metyis. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms, OCC REST APIs, and translating business needs into technical solutions using AI-assisted delivery, I'd love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to the HUGO BOSS Digital Campus.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior IT Consultant eCommerce - AI solutions (Fashion) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior IT Consultant eCommerce position at Metyis in Porto. With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, OCC REST APIs, and data integrations for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise and extensive use of AI-assisted delivery.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to the HUGO BOSS Digital Campus.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
